results.name: Flood in Ecuador
results.reason: On the 26 February 2025 at 16 :00 UTC, heavy rainfall affected especially western and coastal Ecuador causing floods and triggering landslides. The event caused casualties and significant damage. Copernicus EMS Rapid Mapping was requested to provide flood extent emergency mapping.
results.activator: EC Services|DG-ECHO, DG DEFIS, DG DEVCO, DG HOME, DG JRC
